Name.Value: Hour of finished candle open time
Scheduled bullish buy: one unit at market
Scheduled bearish sell: one unit at market
Outside-hour short exit: buy one unit at market
Outside-hour long exit: sell one unit at market
BTC candles, SMA values, filled position and all fills

Scheme.Description: On each finished BTCUSDT thirty-minute candle, samples formed SMA(8) and SMA(21), uses the candle open-time hour as a causal schedule, and performs one fixed-volume market action when the hour, trend, position and eight-bar cooldown rules agree.
